## Activity

During July 2019, the River Outreach clinic team completed 63 captures. This activity provides the recorded workload for the month and supports review of the service’s image capture and grading performance. The capture total should be considered alongside the image-quality and grading results below. Any operational matters identified during the activity should be recorded through the appropriate service process so that they can be reviewed and followed up.

## Image quality

Of the 63 captures, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.3%. This result should be monitored as part of routine quality review. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Maintaining a record of these issues will support identification of repeated problems and help inform future operational follow-up.

## Grading

There were 6 referable results during July 2019. The median grading lag was 1 day. Together, the referable result count and the median grading lag provide a summary of grading activity for the month. The results should be reviewed with the capture and image-quality information to support ongoing oversight of the River Outreach service. Any recurring issues affecting capture quality or grading should continue to be documented through the relevant service arrangements.
